title: Bug 614967: Skip mismatched TransferFields in posting
summary: Sales and Purchase posting now skip fields with mismatched types when transferring from source to posted records, allowing posting to continue even when extension fields reuse the same field numbers with different data types.
key_points: TransferFields calls in Sales-Post and Purch.-Post now skip fields with mismatched types
Posting continues instead of failing on extension field-number collisions
Compatible same-numbered fields are still transferred
Mismatched fields keep the target record's default value
Applied to W1 and the localized copies of codeunits 80 and 90
quote: posting continues, compatible same-numbered fields are still transferred, and fields whose AL types do not match remain at the target record's default value
